title: CLEVA: Chinese Language Models EVAluation Platform
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. Its 'Harms' evaluation focused on toxicity, copyright, disinformation, and bias related to race, gender, region, and occupation, but not religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of its evaluation.
